AUTHOR: Huang
TITLE: Hierarchical classification with reject option for live fish recognition
SPECIES: 15 reef species (D. reticulatus, A. clarkii, C. chrysura, P. dickii, M. kuntee, L. fulvus, ...) plus 8 unknown species for rejection
DATA: Fish4Knowledge live fish dataset (24,150 labelled images of 15 species + 3,220 images of unknown species); 3 additional real videos (1000 detections each)
V_EV: Sec. 4 / Fig. 6 caption: 'Hard fish examples, due to blurry conditions, different distances/orientations, against coral or ocean floor backgrounds.' No quantitative visibility measure; no stratified results.
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'The training (3/5's) and testing sets (1/5's) are isolated so fish images from the same trajectory sequence are not used during both training and testing.'
R_EV: Sec. 4 / 4.3: all data from the same south Taiwan sea live fish dataset; 'We choose 3 underwater videos and have labelled 1000 detections from each video.' Same source, no different site/camera/dataset.
C_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'set a small threshold (i.e. 0.01) to reject all samples whose posterior probabilities are below the threshold'; Table 6 caption: 'In each video we select the first 1000 detections and manually label all samples.' Table 7 reports false detections / TR / FR.
E_EV: Tables 1, 4, 5, 6: only AR / AP / AC / F1-score and rejection rates reported; no ecological variable (counts, MaxN, abundance) derived.
ARCH: Hand-crafted features (colour histograms, GLCM texture, Gabor, Fourier, moment invariants, PHOG; 2626 dims) + Forward Sequential Feature Selection + hierarchical SVM tree (BEOTR) + GMM/Bayes posterior reject option; trajectory voting
METR: Average Recall, Average Precision, Accuracy over Count, F1-score, True Rejection / False Rejection rates
NOTE: Not a deep-learning paper (SVM + GMM). Split is 5-fold CV grouped by fish trajectory (images from one trajectory never span train/test) — coded as k-fold(이미지) with D3=Y/D4=Y, giving D_ALL=P; a verifier may prefer treating trajectory-level grouping as closer to video-level. C3='기타' reflects GMM-based posterior probability used as an uncertainty/reject mechanism (not MC dropout/ensemble/Bayesian NN); Fig. 4 shows posterior-probability distributions of TP vs FP but no ECE/reliability diagram, so C2=없음. C5: Sec. 4.3 manually labels 1000 detections per video in 3 new videos and reports false detections and rejection rates. Sec. 4.3 'new real videos' and 3,220 unknown-species images are from the same monitoring system (open-set test, not external domain) → R1=N. NVID='보고됨' refers only to the 3 test videos in Sec. 4.3; the number of source videos for the 24,150 images is not given. V_ALL=P arises mechanically from V1=정성 서술만 (blurry images, changing illumination mentioned in words only).
